bet: Adding an exponential saturation term Y*(1-exp(-k*|eps|))*sign(eps) on top of the power-law hardening provides a smoother, more physically accurate representation of the elastic-plastic transition and post-yield plateau in aluminium. The exponential term naturally saturates, complementing the unbounded power-law term and giving the optimizer more flexibility to fit both the initial yield region and the hardening regime independently. This structural addition (from inspiration 1's exponential form) combined with the current power-law core creates a richer model that may better capture the non-monotonic curvature observed in real stress-strain data.
